seed: Omit one non-interface original with maximum new-point neighbours, tie-break by lowest original label, to prevent a trivial return to unchanged L.
algorithm: On initial UNSAT take an assumption core, then original-first deterministic core-guided deletion. Check each SAT colouring directly. Keep latest native-UNSAT support and independently certify its final exact forbidden-interface CNF. Stop at128 reduction queries or exhausted order. No second seed.
